plugins.name: coffeejson
plugins.description: Agent skills for CoffeeJSON. One for changing the format, covering schema validation, field design, and landing a change fixture-first. One for integrating it into an app, service or site, covering the integration patterns, the intake and export checklists, transport, the SDKs, and conformance. One for writing a document from a published source, covering faithful transcription, field placement, vocabulary mapping, and validation.
